Library.CardTip:
Open the match: replay, decks and analysis.
Keys: ↑ ↓ — games, Enter — open, → — the card's buttons, ← or Esc — back, S — star, Shift+S — Share, Delete — delete an imported game, O — open on the site.
Library.ImportTip: Open a .hpr replay or a Power.log. You can also paste a file or its path: Ctrl+V
Library.Imported.Log: {0} game from the log is in Imported.|{0} games from the log are in Imported.
Library.Imported.None: This log has no finished games.
Library.Imported.Already: This game is already in Imported.
Library.ImportError.NotReplay: it is neither a Hearthpulse replay nor a Power.log
Library.ImportError.Damaged: the file is damaged or was altered
Library.ImportError.Version: this replay format is not supported
Library.ImportError.Unreadable: the file could not be read
Library.ImportError.Clipboard: the clipboard holds no file or path
Library.Star.Add: Save: the replay copy is never cleaned up
Library.Star.ConfirmLast: This is the only copy of the replay: remove it from Saved and delete it?
Library.Star.Failed: Could not save a copy of the replay: check the free disk space and access to the Documents folder.
Library.Share: Share: the replay file to the clipboard, without ranks, rating and the time of play
Library.Shared: The replay file is on the clipboard: paste it into a chat or a folder.
Library.SharedPath: Open the folder and drag the file into the chat.
Library.Damaged: The replay is damaged or was altered: it cannot be opened
Library.ShareFailed: Could not prepare the replay file.
Library.NoReplay: No replay: the game predates replays or its file was deleted
Library.Empty.Saved: Click the star on a game to keep its replay: saved replays are never cleaned up.
Library.Empty.Imported: Import a .hpr replay or a Power.log with Import, or paste the file: Ctrl+V.
Library.Site.UploadTip: Upload to the site: a public link to this game (asks first)
Library.Site.RemoveTip: On the site: {0}. Click to delete it from the site
Library.Site.ConfirmUpload: Upload this game to hearthpulse.net? The link will be public.
Library.Site.ConfirmRemove: Delete this replay from the site? Its link stops working.
Library.Site.SignIn: Sign in to your hearthpulse.net account in Settings to upload replays.
Library.Site.Error.SIGNED_OUT: The site sign-in has ended: sign in again in Settings.
Library.Site.Error.OFFLINE: The site cannot be reached. Try again later.
Library.Site.Error.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your account keeps the most replays it may: delete some on the site first.
Library.Site.Error.TOO_LARGE: This replay is too large for the site.
Library.Site.Error.NOT_AVAILABLE: Uploading replays to the site isn't switched on yet. It's coming soon.
Library.Site.Error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many uploads in a row: try again in an hour.
Library.Site.Error.REFUSED: The site did not take this replay.
Library.Site.Error.SERVER_ERROR: The site could not save the replay. Try again later.
Library.Site.Uploading: Uploading to the site… Click to cancel
Library.Site.Cancelled: Upload cancelled. If the site had already taken the replay, it is in the list on your account page.
Library.Site.Gone: This replay is no longer on the site.
Library.Site.DeleteError.OFFLINE: The site cannot be reached; the replay is not deleted. Try again later.
Library.Site.DeleteError.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests: try deleting again in a minute.
Library.Site.DeleteError.REFUSED: The site refused to delete the replay.
Library.Site.DeleteError.SERVER_ERROR: The site could not delete the replay. Try again later.
Library.Search.Name: Search games
Library.Search.Tip: Looks in the hero and class, the opponent and its archetype, the mode, format, deck and result. Ctrl+F to search, Esc to clear.
Library.Search.ResultTip: Filter by result. In Battlegrounds a win is places 1–4, in Duos 1–2.
Library.Search.Empty: Nothing matches “{0}”. Check the spelling or clear the search.
Library.Search.EmptyResult: No games with this result on this tab.
